en.topic_title: Nat. security police reportedly arrest independent journalist over ‘fake news’
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s national security police have reportedly arrested an independent journalist behind an online news outlet on suspicion of publishing fake news.



Tang Ho-wing in a YouTube video. Photo: Screenshot via Boom News.



According to a report by Sing Tao Headline on Wednesday, the National Security Department of the Hong Kong Police Force carried out the arrest of journalist Tang Ho-wing, who runs the online news outlet Boom News, at 7am that morning.
